subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp suppress composing for all passive unmentioned group runs, including automatic-delivery turns that may rarely send a proactive visible reply, or should maintainers prefer the broader send-start typing boundary?
rationale: The code can be rebased mechanically, but tests cannot decide the user-visible WhatsApp typing contract or whether the missing typing flash on proactive replies is acceptable.

options.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Refresh this PR onto current main using conversationKind/groupMention context and keep tests for automatic, message-tool-only, mentioned, direct, and authorized-command cases.

options.title: Prefer Visible Delivery Boundary
options.body: Pause this PR and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 only after its conflicts, API compatibility, and proof gaps are resolved.

options.title: Accept The UX Tradeoff
options.body: Approve the policy that passive unmentioned WhatsApp group runs never show composing, even when a rare proactive visible reply is later delivered.

recommendation.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR onto current main using conversationKind/groupMention context and keep tests for automatic, message-tool-only, mentioned, direct, and authorized-command cases.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery PR and has recent merged history in the WhatsApp inbound dispatch area.
